items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: But I played with him. ... I've been recording with Emile, too.

ctx.x: I was going to ask, what kind of a band did Fisher have? Fisher. Johnny Fisher? Is it a brass band? No, he had an orchestra. Pretty good. It wasn't rag? Pretty good. Pretty good. Chiller used to play with him. Was it ragtime? And this fellow Shannon. This fellow Shannon had with me. He used to play with him too. Fisher had a good band. Was it ragtime? Fisher's band. Ragtime. Yeah. Rag music, yeah. And he used to have, oh, I can't think of his name now. He was on the police a while, playing trombone with him.…
The three of the Christians. Frank, too. Frank, Emile, and Charlie.
